coverage.note: Later-pass search, not a first surname sweep. Searched ac.jp with given-name tokens Thanh, Hieu, Quynh, Thuy, Khuong, Cuong, Tuyet, Nhung, Hanh, Dung, Bich, Diep, Huyen, Toan, Lien, Hoai, Hau, Hien, Loan, Thang, Ngoc, Thinh, Chau, Giang, Viet, Chinh, Duy, Bao, Huy, Thien, Huong, Tung, Minh, Quang, Duc and Linh, and less-common surnames Huynh, Phung, Luu, Nghiem, Ta, Luong, Kieu, Quach, Dinh and Trinh. English and Japanese rank terms were used. Many results were Vietnam-based visitors, students, papers, or already listed. Search results were discovery only; eight candidates were verified on live employer pages. Broad targeted coverage achieved, not a claim of an exhaustive census. No LinkedIn pages fetched, no login, no Issues/PRs, no roster changes.
Hieu/Hanh given-name discovery found a new data-engineering associate professor; full-time faculty corroboration and degrees checked.
Tuyet/Nhung sweep reached this smaller private university. New business/economics candidate distinguished from Toronto historian.
Thao discovery reached regenerative medicine. Individual biography checked in both languages; the same-name Osaka materials researcher was independently resolved.
New motion-control assistant professor verified. Mai Dung Do held out because no individual employer biography was opened. Staff tables clearly distinguish visiting and ordinary faculty.

Huyen sweep found materials and computer-vision leads. One regular assistant professor verified after resolving historical 特任 status; EMCR appointment held out. The old web.imr newsletter URL failed; the discovered sc.imr university PDF opened.

Loan discovery found new Vietnamese-studies faculty. Live direct HTTP requests recovered individual research profiles after web-tool 502s. Current SANKEN profile resolved Hamamatsu namesake. Vietnamese-language 特任 teachers were not candidates.

Quynh token reached a new regular civil-engineering assistant professor. Individual faculty biography returned HTTP 200 via shell; browser directory search redirected to maintenance. Older IIS project appointments were distinguished from current engineering appointment.

Thuy search exposed HoangNam Tran through research records. Live individual EDB page establishes regular full-time primary faculty, current International Center affiliation from April 2026, and explicitly dated doctorate. Browser timeout resolved by direct HTTP 200 fetch.
Less-common Huynh sweep reached business-English faculty. Current appointment verified but doctorate-or-recent-papers requirement not met; official degree is a master's.
Nghiem sweep returned vp-1307; not a new candidate.
Ta/given-name sweep returned vp-0990; already listed.
Huynh/given-name sweep returned vp-1198 under reordered published name; already listed.

Search-scoped Quynh and other given names. Award-story collaborator Thi Nhu Quynh Phan lacked an individual current employer/appointment verification; not counted. Student and Vietnam-based collaborator results rejected during triage.

Additional institution-scoped searches targeted Kochi, Toyohashi University of Technology, Akita, Fukui, Okayama, Kyushu Institute of Technology, Saga, Yamaguchi, Ehime, Ryukoku and Setsunan with given-name tokens and faculty terms. These were search-level probes, not full directory audits; no additional individually verified permanent candidate resulted. Mixed-OR queries often returned generic directories, so single-token institution queries were also tried. They should not be interpreted as complete negative institutional censuses.

No unsourced Vietnamese diacritics, doctorate years, or locations were manufactured. Personal/lab links retained only where employer-linked and identity-resolved. No qualifying major honors were established in this pass; routine poster/paper awards omitted. Portraits not downloaded or proposed without visual verification. Scholar link supplied only for the account explicitly linked by the current Tohoku lab. Some researchmap links returned 403 and were used only as identity URLs in local dedup, not verification evidence.
